headline: Danantara Financial Statements Receive Unqualified Opinion from BPK
summary: The Supreme Audit Agency (BPK) gave Danantara an unqualified (WTP) opinion on its 2025 financial statements. The opinion is the highest audit grade.
why: The BPK is Indonesia's state audit body, and an unqualified opinion indicates the financial statements are free of material misstatement. This matters for governance assessments of state-linked investment vehicles.
original_headline: Lapkeu Danantara Dapat Opini Wajar Tanpa Pengecualian dari BPK
